name: verify-progressive
stdout:
PASS first complete round is usable before completed resolves
PASS forward HDR uses the new first-round texture without old-field warm start
PASS each completed progressive round is displayed in a distinct frame
PASS published/read/write ownership refers only to completed reads and separate writes
PASS same N-bounce progressive and snapshot E/moments/final HDR agree
PASS rapid requests publish during input and settle the newest revision
PASS superseded promises reject and obsolete deeper rounds are skipped
PASS publication versions are monotonic and pending work is bounded
PASS on-demand rendering stops GI submissions and frames after settling
PASS actual GL texture/FBO resources remain stable and shader cache does not grow
PASS destroy rejects both lighting promises and pending worker requests
PASS initialization failure rejects preview/final and releases resources
PASS reload restores all rounds without GL feedback, errors or blocking waits
PASS no unexpected render/worker/browser errors
